mods.description: Holds recursive deletes and shows how many files they would remove
Adds a project brief to every prompt
Shows context window use in the status bar and chat band
Dims the sidebar, inspector and header while an agent turn runs, with a /focus-dim command and a Ctrl+Shift+F key to switch it off or on
Adds your house rules to the system prompt of new sessions
Fireworks over the window when a watched pull request merges
A synthwave look whose chat surface shifts mood with the turn: tinted while the agent works, a flash on shell calls, red on errors, fireworks on a merge
Gives the agent a todo_count tool that counts TODO and FIXME comments in the open project
Keeps short notes per chat in a pane beside the chat
Rewrites bare npm install to npm ci
Context weather band: tier, percent, used and limit, a per-turn sparkline and the last turn's growth
Puts a badge before shell calls in the chat and folds long tool output into one line
Shows how long the running turn has taken in the chat band
